entities.summary: The Sevens is a rugby sevens stadium in Ūd al-Baydāʾ, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The Sevens Stadium is a venue for rugby, association football, Gaelic football, Australian football, netball, basketball, cricket, tennis, track and field, baseball, and concerts.
